defs.def: the space between two lines or surfaces that join, measured in degrees 角

ex.s: She writes from the practical angle of a business person rather than as an academic, making for a guide which is highly accessible and informative and which, by the close, will make you feel almost as smart as AI.
ex.t: 她以商人的务实角度而非学者的角度写作，使这本指南通俗易懂、内容丰富，读完后会让你觉得自己几乎和人工智能一样聪明。

ex.s: 6/19 — Waterfalls &Wide Angles: meet at Artist Point.
ex.t: 6月19日——瀑布与广角：在艺术家点集合。

ex.s: We have looked at our planet from every angle and found all of the wildest things left to find.
observe the President at a right angle

defs.def: the direction that sth is leaning or pointing in when it is not in a vertical or horizontal line 斜角；角度

ex.s: Cooperating with people from diverse cultural backgrounds helps us view the world from different angles and thus gives us more insight into our own culture.
ex.t: 与来自不同文化背景的人合作有助于我们从不同角度看待世界，从而让我们更深入地了解自己的文化。

ex.s: The only thing I can remember from school maths is that the angles of a triangle add up to 180 degrees!
ex.t: 我从学校数学中唯一记得的是，三角形的角度加起来是180度！

ex.s: Peter Jackson, director of The Lord of the Rings films, took a creative approach-he used clever camera angles to make characters seem bigger or smaller than they really were.
ex.t: 《指环王》电影的导演彼得·杰克逊（ Peter Jackson ）采用了一种创造性的方法--他使用巧妙的相机角度让角色看起来比实际更大或更小。

ex.s: The steel rails were twisted into different angles, the telephone and telegraph systems were cut off, and the great water mains had burst.
ex.t: 钢轨被扭曲成不同的角度，电话和电报系统被切断，大水管破裂。

defs.def: a position from which you look at sth 角度
a particular way of presenting or thinking about a situation, problem, etc. 观点；立场；角度
to move or place sth so that it is not straight or not directly facing sb/sth 斜移；斜置
to present information, a report, etc. based on a particular way of thinking or for a particular audience 以（某角度）报道；以（某观点）提供信息

ex.s: Organise the information and explain the concept from different angles.
ex.t: 整理信息并从不同角度解释概念。

defs.def: to catch fish with a line and a hook 垂钓；钓鱼
